exposure: Infants with a normal Barlow and Ortolani exam (n=151)
cohort: 237 infants born breech with a normal physical examination, all delivered by cesarean section
finding: Routine ultrasound screening for developmental dysplasia of the hip in infants born breech with a normal physical exam may not be necessary, and a more cost-effective approach could involve clinical follow-up with an X-ray at 4 months of age.
mod_finding: All infants in the study were delivered by cesarean section.
